v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Proprio de Tempore

text.la: Viri Galilǽi, * quid aspícitis in cælum? Hic Iesus qui assúmptus est a vobis in cælum, sic véniet, allelúia.
text.en: Ye men of Galilee, * why stand ye gazing up into heaven? This same Jesus, Which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner, alleluia.

text.la: Cumque intueréntur * in cælum eúntem illum, dixérunt, allelúia.
text.en: And while they looked * steadfastly towards heaven, as He went up, they said, alleluia.

text.la: Elevátis mánibus, * benedíxit eis, et ferebátur in cælum, allelúia.
text.en: He lifted up His Hands, * and blessed them, and was carried up into heaven, alleluia.

text.la: Exaltáte Regem regum, * et hymnum dícite Deo, allelúia.
text.en: Extol the King of kings, * and ascribe praise to God, alleluia.

text.la: Vidéntibus illis, * elevátus est, et nubes suscépit eum in cælo, allelúia.
text.en: While they beheld, * He was taken up, and a cloud received Him in heaven, alleluia.

text.la: Primum quidem sermónem feci de ómnibus, o Theóphile, quæ cœpit Iesus fácere et docére usque in diem, qua præcípiens Apóstolis per Spíritum Sanctum, quos elégit, assúmptus est.
text.en: The former treatise I made, O Theophilus, of all things which Jesus began to do and to teach, Until the day on which, giving commandments by the Holy Ghost to the apostles whom he had chosen, he was taken up.

v.en: God is ascended with jubilee, alleluia.

r.la: Et Dóminus in voce tubæ, allelúia.
r.en: And the Lord with the sound of trumpet, alleluia.

text.la: Pater, * manifestávi nomen tuum homínibus quos dedísti mihi: nunc autem pro eis rogo, non pro mundo, quia ad te vénio, allelúia.
text.en: Father, * I have manifested thy Name unto the men which Thou gavest Me but now I pray for them, not for the world, because I come to thee, alleluia.

text.la: Concéde, quǽsumus, omnípotens Deus: ut, qui hodiérna die Unigénitum tuum, Redemptórem nostrum, ad cælos ascendísse crédimus; ipsi quoque mente in cæléstibus habitémus.
text.en: Grant, we beseech thee, Almighty God, that just as we do believe thine Only-Begotten Son, our Saviour, to have this day ascended into the heavens, so we may also in heart and mind thither ascend, and with Him continually dwell.
